# Migration reconciliation

An implementation owner compares source and target records after normalization. Reconcile email, status and incremental records, not only row counts.

## Input and contract
input/fixture.json; input/dictionary.md; project version 1

## Finding and reproducible output
```json
{
  "normalized": [
    {
      "id": "U1",
      "email": "alice@example.invalid",
      "status": "active"
    },
    {
      "id": "U2",
      "email": "bob@example.invalid",
      "status": "pending"
    }
  ],
  "differences": [
    "U2"
  ],
  "rollbackAllowed": false,
  "preserve": [
    "U3"
  ]
}
```

## Failure prevented
Equal row counts do not excuse a wrong status or loss of new records.

## Decision and limits
Accept only the specified result set. Escalate a missing identity, permission, business probe or required not-run item. This is an original synthetic teaching reference, not evidence of learner execution or real employment.
